question: The dev-services free_tier vocabulary has users for monthly-active-user counts but no term for ZITADEL's daily-active-user (DAU) meter or Stack Auth's total-account count. Should the schema add a daily-active-users unit or a distinct total-accounts unit?
why: ZITADEL Cloud (dev-services/zitadel-cloud) counts a unique user once per day and sums the days, so 100 DAU is not 100 users; Stack Auth (dev-services/stack-auth) counts all accounts including inactive ones. Both use the nearest term users and name the true unit in free_tier.notes.
